description: Set the contact forces consistent with the zone stresses. This is accomplished by averaging the zone stresses associated with each contact and computing a traction on the contact plane from the stress tensor. The contact force is the ratio of the traction to the contact area for each contact. Zone stresses must be specified prior to giving this command. The range applies to contacts.
notes: Documented in the 'wad' (wall-and-discontinuity) doc tree, not under flac3d/ -- which is why this family is absent from the FLAC zone corpus.
Live-probed on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14). Availability in FLAC3D is unverified.
